answer.text: The English and Japanese versions conflict. The English says the 10% service charge is added to all lunch orders, while the Japanese original says it applies at lunch only to customers ordering a course.

citations.quote: (A 10% service charge will be added to all lunch orders.)
（ランチ利用時はコースご注文のお客様のみサービス料10％を頂戴しております）
